description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the first call returns the payment terms, pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). Resolve one link the way a browser would: follows up to 10 redirects (HEAD first, GET fallback), returns alive true/false with a reason (http_404, dns_not_found, timeout...), the final URL and domain, every hop with its status, cross-domain and HTTPS-downgrade flags, URL-shortener detection, content type/length, Last-Modified/ETag, X-Robots-Tag and TLS validity. Dead links are an answer, not an error. Cached up to 5 min. ~0.3-3 s.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

title: Link check: is it alive, where does it really go (redirects resolved)
